name: survey-library

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Dropdown popup is as narrow as the input when the question title is on the left [creator:8123] by @OlgaLarina in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12190
* Update postcss test script and add postcss-surveyjs dependency; adjus… by @MarchTokenda in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12213

* fix(core): report nested errors in getAllErrors of composite and sele… by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12212
* Fix #12214, clear errors on calling survey.clear function by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12215
* perf(paneldynamic): serialize the template once per batch of new panels by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12216

* test(e2e): replace fixed waits in e2e/survey and e2e/components by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12219
* test(survey-core): split the three long dynamic-data test files by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12208
* Fix flaky unit test: what a removed-event handler sees under paging > panel with an asynch… by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12202

* fix(core): reset re-entrancy flags when user code throws by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12207
* perf(matrixdynamic): rebind the rows on a sort and a page move instead of rebuilding them by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12205
* Each matrix cell of the column's cell type was built from a fresh `to… by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12206
* fix(ui): cancel native form submit without an inline handler by @JaneSjs in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12224
* Feature/ai request interfaces by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12209
* feat(survey-core): per-survey settings and constructor options by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12235
* fix(survey-core): completion clears a value hidden by clearing anothe… by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12236
* fix(survey-core): an escaped backslash in a pattern mask is a literal backslash by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12239

* fix(survey-core): a text that only starts with 0x is not a number by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12234
* fix(survey-core): keep an edited matrix's rows in step with its array… by @andrewtelnov in https://github.com/surveyjs/survey-library/pull/12232
